2608.30674.title: CoMPASS: Collaborative Molecular Property Prediction via Adaptive Small-Large Model Synergy
2608.30674.paper_summary: Accurate molecular property prediction requires both statistical reliability and chemical reasoning. Graph neural networks can be calibrated directly on labeled assays but remain limited by the coverage of their training data. Large language models (LLMs) can compare molecular evidence and articulate chemical rationales, yet are unreliable as standalone quantitative predictors. The central challenge is therefore to determine when an LLM should influence a calibrated model and by how much. Here we present CoMPASS, a retrieval-calibrated framework for small-large model collaboration. CoMPASS retains a graph attention network (GAT) as the predictive anchor, retrieves locally relevant training molecules, provides attention-grounded evidence to an LLM, and converts its proposal into a bounded correction through an agreement-aware gate. Across six classification and two regression benchmarks, CoMPASS improves the GAT anchor in regions of correctable uncertainty while limiting LLM intervention in high-confidence regimes. Ablations show that the gains arise from validation-calibrated retrieval and bounded fusion rather than prompting alone. These results suggest that generative reasoning should augment calibrated prediction through evidence-grounded, controlled corrections rather than direct output replacement. Code is available at https://github.com/littlepeachs/CoMPASS.
2608.30674.paper_summary_zh: 準確的分子性質預測需要統計可靠性和化學推理。圖神經網絡可以直接在標記的測試上進行校準，但仍然受到訓練數據覆蓋範圍的限制。大型語言模型（LLMs）可以比較分子證據並表達化學推理，但作為獨立的定量預測工具卻不可靠。因此，主要挑戰在於確定何時應該讓LLM影響校準模型，以及影響的程度。這裡我們提出了CoMPASS，一個用於小型和大型模型協作的檢索校準框架。CoMPASS保留了一個圖注意力網絡（GAT）作為預測基準，檢索本地相關的訓練分子，向LLM提供基於注意力的證據，並通過一個考慮協議的閘門將其提議轉換為有界的修正。在六個分類和兩個回歸基準中，CoMPASS在可修正的不確定性區域改善了GAT基準，同時限制了LLM在高信心範疇中的干預。消融實驗顯示，這些增益來自於驗證校準的檢索和有界融合，而不僅僅是提示。這些結果表明，生成推理應該通過基於證據的、受控的修正來增強校準預測，而不是直接替換輸出。代碼可在 https://github.com/littlepeachs/CoMPASS 獲得。
